contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP CARAVSIVS[--] ; R/ SA[LVS AVG]

Copper alloy with silver wash coin. Radiate of Carausius (286-293). Obverse description: Radiate bust draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP CARAVSIVS[--]. Reverse description: Salus standing left feeding snake rising from altar and holding sceptre. Reverse inscription: SA[LVS AVG]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin, citing Sear volume 4 no. 13709 [type]. Diameter: 22.9mm, Weight: 2.23gms, die axis: 3. This coin has been considered for Sam Moorhead's corpus for RIC
